scenarios.title: Pearwick identity resolves from admitted source data
scenarios.objective: Confirm House name, heraldry, Council membership, responsibility ownership, and portraits agree with current admitted read models.
invariants: No presentation fixture becomes runtime truth
No unresolved identity silently substitutes another person

scenarios.title: Holtcross identity and heraldry remain isolated
scenarios.objective: Confirm the Council room, portraits, heraldry, people, and responsibilities are Holtcross-derived with no Pearwick leakage.
invariants: No cross-House asset leakage
Decorative heraldry is spatially integrated rather than floating

scenarios.title: Named portraits resolve without incorrect fallbacks
scenarios.objective: Inspect Council and responsibility people and verify resolved portrait identities, honest missing states, and absence of wrong-person fallbacks.
invariants: A missing portrait is not replaced by a different known person
Portrait resolution is source-driven

scenarios.title: Unavailable responsibility evidence remains honest
scenarios.objective: Open a responsibility whose detailed evidence is not admitted and verify the UI describes the unavailable state without fabricated facts or precision.
invariants: No candidate data is promoted
Unavailable is distinct from zero or none

scenarios.title: Head of House receives appropriate command access
scenarios.objective: Verify Head-level navigation and available responsibility-assignment actions without assuming operational knowledge the Head has not received.
invariants: Authority does not imply omniscience
Unavailable commands explain why

scenarios.title: Principal owner can inspect the domain but not exceed House authority
scenarios.objective: Verify domain and responsibility detail access while preventing commands reserved to the Head or regent.
invariants: Principal ownership is not universal House command
One person may own multiple responsibilities

scenarios.title: Council membership is not responsibility ownership
scenarios.actor: Inner Council member without an assigned responsibility
scenarios.objective: Select the person for overall Council context and verify that no false exclusive responsibility or operational command is inferred.
invariants: Council membership remains independent of responsibility ownership

scenarios.title: Knowledge limits survive responsibility drill-down
scenarios.actor: Head or regent who has not assumed the responsibility
scenarios.objective: Inspect a delegated responsibility and verify detailed facts remain categorical, estimated, withheld, or attributed as the source contract requires.
invariants: Drill-down does not create omniscience
Precision reflects source knowledge

scenarios.title: Council to Household to Stores to Details flow
scenarios.objective: Traverse Inner Council to Household place to Household Stores responsibility workspace to details and return without losing context.
invariants: Place precedes responsibility
Details appear above the working place
Return restores the prior selection

scenarios.title: Person conversation and domain navigation remain distinct
scenarios.objective: Select one Council participant for their overall report, then separately enter a domain they happen to own, proving the person is not an exclusive drill-down link.
invariants: Person selection is not domain selection
A person can lead to more than one domain

scenarios.title: Modal, browser history, and focus restoration
scenarios.objective: Open and close responsibility detail, use browser back and forward, and verify focus, House, room, and selection state are restored predictably.
invariants: No context reset
No inaccessible focus trap
Deep-link state is honest

scenarios.title: Narrow viewport retains the governing flow
scenarios.objective: Repeat Council to domain to responsibility to detail at a narrow viewport and verify navigation, hierarchy, reading order, and modal dismissal.
invariants: Responsive treatment does not collapse into an unexplained worksheet
Primary actions remain reachable

scenarios.title: Configured player House uses the shared runtime system
scenarios.actor: local player controlling the configured House; in-world actor unadmitted
scenarios.objective: Verify Council, domain rooms, responsibilities, portraits, and heraldry resolve from the configured player context and source contracts rather than component fallbacks.
invariants: No House-specific component fallback
Empty states remain intentional

scenarios.title: Unadmitted manor associations fail closed
scenarios.actor: local player controlling the configured House; in-world actor unadmitted
scenarios.objective: Enter Estate & Holdings and verify the current zero-admission spatial contract presents an explicit unavailable state without provisional manor names, selectors, or operating details.
invariants: Candidate manor associations never enter the player runtime
No substitute holdings are invented

scenarios.title: Alternate House selectors do not gain operational access
scenarios.actor: local player without entitlement to the selected House
scenarios.objective: Attempt an alternate-House product deep link and verify the UI and all operational APIs deny access before returning Council, Household, person, responsibility, or spatial data.
invariants: URL selection never grants House entitlement
Denied responses contain no selected-House details

scenarios.title: Spatial absence preserves House and place context
scenarios.actor: local player controlling the configured House; in-world actor unadmitted
scenarios.objective: Open Estate & Holdings with no UI-admitted House-to-manor association and return to the Council without losing the configured House or place hierarchy.
invariants: Map supports rather than replaces the operational room
Spatial claims resolve only from the admitted House-scoped contract
Provisional operator crosswalk rows are absent from browser payloads and UI

scenarios.title: Monthly, annual, and triennial clocks remain distinct
scenarios.objective: Inspect planning, status, and evidence dates and verify that monthly simulation evidence is not misrepresented as an annual evaluation or executed three-year plan.
invariants: The three clocks are labeled or inferable without false precision

scenarios.title: Pending, executed, stale, and unavailable states differ
scenarios.objective: Compare at least two responsibility records with different temporal states and verify their language and actions cannot be confused.
invariants: Pending is not executed
Stale is not current
Unavailable is not zero

scenarios.title: Extraordinary succession interruption is honest
scenarios.objective: If an admitted interruption fixture exists, verify authority and continuity after a mid-turn death; otherwise verify the tester reports the scenario as unavailable rather than fabricating a pass.
invariants: No invented temporal fixture
Authority moves only through admitted state
evidenceRequired: runtime evidence or explicit unavailable proof

scenarios.title: Room-to-workspace-to-detail presentation follows the locked system
scenarios.objective: Compare the Council room and one built domain flow across two Houses for integrated heraldry, room identity, hierarchy, overlays, and avoidance of dashboard/worksheet treatment.
invariants: House identity belongs in the environment
Responsibility work occurs in a domain place
Messy details appear above the place
The map remains subordinate
